# HUNKAR 24 (हुंकार 24) – राजस्थान की बुलंद आवाज़

> HUNKAR 24 is a premier, independent digital Hindi news media network focused on Rajasthan and national public-interest journalism. It provides real-time breaking news, verified ground reports, administrative governance updates, employment (RPSC / RSMSSB), agricultural mandi bhav, and welfare schemes.

## Website & Canonical Identity
- **Primary Domain**: https://hunkar24.netlify.app
- **Language**: Hindi (hi-IN) / Devanagari Script
- **Publisher**: Hunkar 24 Digital News Network
- **Headquarters**: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- **Core Coverage**: Rajasthan (all 33+ districts), National Affairs, Public Welfare Schemes, Farmer & Mandi Updates, Education & Govt Jobs

## Core Editorial Sections
- [Rajasthan State News](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/rajasthan): Daily political, social, and developmental updates from Rajasthan.
- [Education & Government Jobs](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/jobs): RPSC, REET, RSMSSB recruitment exam dates, notifications, and answer keys.
- [Government Welfare Schemes](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/schemes): In-depth reporting on state and central welfare policies (Jal Jeevan Mission, Chiranjeevi, Free Electricity, Housing).
- [Agriculture & Mandi Bhav](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/agriculture): Daily crop prices, weather warnings, and agrarian technology reports across Rajasthan mandis.
- [Ground Reports](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/ground-report): In-depth investigative journalism from rural villages, the Thar Desert border, and urban municipal issues.
- [Video News Bulletins](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/): Verified video reports and legislative assembly debates.
- [National & Political Affairs](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/national): National headlines, policy decisions, and geopolitical insights in Hindi.

## Hyperlocal Rajasthan District Hubs
- [Jaipur (जयपुर)](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/jaipur): Capital news, secretariat announcements, heritage development, urban civic issues.
- [Churu (चूरू)](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/churu): Shekhawati rural ground reports, extreme weather, local governance.
- [Sikar (सीकर)](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/sikar): Education hub, student welfare, agricultural mandi updates, Khatoo Shyamji reports.
- [Bikaner (बीकानेर)](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/bikaner): Desert solar energy parks, livestock, cultural heritage, Junagarh news.
- [Jodhpur (जोधपुर)](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/jodhpur): Marwar judicial updates, handicraft trade, university affairs.
- [Udaipur (उदयपुर)](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/udaipur): Mewar tourism, tribal welfare, lake conservation, environmental news.
- [Kota (कोटा)](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/kota): Student coaching hub, entrance exams (NEET/JEE), mental wellness initiatives.
- [Barmer (बाड़मेर)](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/barmer): International border developments, Thar oilfields, rural water issues.
- [Nagaur (नागौर)](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/nagaur): Makrana marble, rural libraries, agrarian cooperative banking.

## Fact-Checking & Sourcing Policy
- Every news item published on Hunkar 24 cites its primary reporting bureau or official verified governmental source.
- Multi-source cross-verification is applied before publishing breaking news.
- Automated aggregated reports explicitly carry source disclosures and original publisher attribution.
- Citizen submissions undergo editorial verification before being promoted to live articles.

## Feeds & Machine-Readable Endpoints
- [XML Sitemap](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/sitemap.xml): Comprehensive sitemap with Google News XML protocol support.
- [Robots Configuration](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/robots.txt): Crawler rules and sitemap discovery pointers.
- [Public News Feed API](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/api/news-engine/approved): Real-time approved JSON article stream.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Context](https://hunkar24.netlify.app/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive background document for AI agents and LLMs.
